t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Pick a side and stick with it because there is a 50/50 chance of getting it right

vb_textbox.text: Choose a side and stick with that. There is no pattern to the game, it is random chance so it is easier to just go for one side. I chose the right side but I presume it would be the same for left also. It was an easy game and an easy way to make money so hopefully you will have the same luck as me! You basically have a 50/50 chance either way.
